Your plan has a deductible for certain services. The benefit information provided is a summary of
what we cover and what you pay. It doesn’t list every service that we cover or list every limitation
or exclusion. The Evidence of Coverage (EOC) provides a complete list of services we cover.
The deductible applies to the following Medicare-covered benefit categories, unless otherwise
specified

Annual medical deductible

Your deductible is $1,000 per year for covered medical services you receive from providers as
described below. Until you have paid the deductible amount, you must pay the full cost of your
covered medical services.

Here s how it works:

1. You pay your plan’s deductible in full; then,
2. You pay your copay or coinsurance; finally,
3. Your plan pays the rest.

The deductible applies in-network to the following Medicare-covered benefit categories, unless
otherwise specified:

In-network

Inpatient hospital
e Inpatient hospital

* Outpatient hospital, including surgery, excluding diagnostic colonoscopy

Skilled nursing facility (SNF)

Most people who qualify for Medicaid or for the Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB) program
don’t pay deductibles, copayments or coinsurance. If you’re in one of these programs, be sure to
show your proof of Medicaid or QMB eligibility to your provider.

Section 1.2 Our plan deductible

Your deductible is $1,000. Until you’ve paid the deductible amount, you must pay the full cost of
your covered services. After you pay your deductible, we’ll start to pay our share of the costs for
covered medical services, and you’ll pay your copayment or coinsurance amount for the rest of the
calendar year.

The deductible doesn’t apply to some services, including any Medicare-covered services provided
at a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC). This means that we’ll pay our share of the costs for
these services even if you haven’t paid your deductible yet. The deductible applies to the following
services:

e Inpatient hospital care
e Inpatient mental health care
e Ambulatory surgical center (ASC), excluding diagnostic colonoscopy

e Outpatient hospital services, excluding diagnostic colonoscopy
e Outpatient hospital observation services
¢ Skilled nursing facility (SNF) care
